svg.text: In the world beneath all the others, a
bridge collapse kills H.G. Tannhaus's son,
In the origin world's quiet evening, the
Tannhaus family sits down to dinner - the
granddaughter who died in every other
With their cause removed, Adam's world and
Eva's world unravel - everyone in them
fading like mist, including Jonas and
Tannhaus builds a machine to bring his
family back - and instead tears open the
passages that create the two knotted worlds
Tannhaus builds time machine → creates knot
Jonas and Martha follow Claudia's path to
the origin world - the real one, where none
of Winden's knots were ever tied.
The scarred old man ruling Adam's world is
Jonas himself, decades older and convinced
only destruction can end the cycle.
The Martha of Eva's world - the same woman
Jonas loved, living her life mirrored and
The world under all of it: no knot, no
passages, no Winden time-trap - just the
town, and the family that was never saved.
There they stop Tannhaus's family from
dying in the bridge collapse, so the
grieving machine is never built and the two
Prevent family deaths; knot never forms
The mirror world's long war against Adam's
world, each fighting to preserve its own
Eva world war with Adam world
The boy who walked into 2019 and out into
1986 - the father-shaped hole at the centre
The day Winden ends - and the knot's
central point, the moment every loop must
Jonas and Martha, in the true world,
The knotted worlds come undone - not
Beneath Winden, the caves link three eras -
apart, and anything that walks in comes out
A boy, Mikkel, walks into the caves in 2019
and steps out in 1986, where he is raised
by strangers and grows up as Michael
A secret society, Sic Mundus, works across
the centuries to keep the knot of Winden's
history exactly as it is - or, some say, to
Sic Mundus / Erit Lux sustain loops
A book - A Journey Through Time - describes
the time passages in detail, having been
written by a man who learned them inside
A Journey Through Time bootstrap book
In the nuclear plant's depths, the
chair-shaped apparatus and later the God
particle become the means of opening
Winden and anchors the knot: the moment
Adam in one world and Eva in the other each
keep their half of the knot burning -
believing they are saving their world.
Claudia, who has played every side, finds
the truth neither Adam nor Eva ever saw:
both worlds are the flaw, and there is an
Jonas from one world and Martha from its
mirror cross into each other's worlds - the
Jonas and Martha have a child, the Unknown
- an origin that could only happen between
the two knotted worlds, and which belongs
